findings.expected: The blank/whitespace name is refused with a validation message next to the field (as the disabled \"Add\" button implies), and nothing is sent to the server.
findings.actual: Pressing Enter submits the empty name: POST /api/permissions/group returns 400, the console logs \"Error creating group\", and a modal appears that only says \"Something went wrong\" with an Ok button. The \"Add\" button is still greyed out, so this path is inconsistent with the form's own state.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open /admin/people/groups
Click "Create a group"
Type three spaces into the new group name field (placeholder 'Something like "Marketing"')
Press Enter

findings.expected: The display name is saved, the page leaves the edit form or confirms the save, and /admin/databases lists the database as 'agent8-Sample Database'.

The change is not saved: /admin/databases still lists 'Sample Database'. The same edit page's own detail page says the database is 'Connected', so the two pages contradict each other. findings.expected: The field is described as the URL of the map tile server, so a value that is not a URL should be refused with a validation message next to the field and the previous value kept (an empty value falls back to the OpenStreetMap default, so the field is validated at least for emptiness).
findings.actual: The page shows the toast "Changes saved", sends PUT /api/setting/map-tile-server-url → 204, and after a reload the field still contains "not a url". No error is shown and the instance-wide map tile server is now a value that cannot render tiles.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open Admin > Settings > Maps (/admin/settings/maps).
Click the 'Map tile server URL' field, which holds https://{s}.tile.openstreetmap.org/{z}/{x}/{y}.png, clear it and type: not a url
Press Tab to leave the field (the setting saves on blur).
Reload the page.

findings.name: A segment name made only of spaces enables \"Save changes\", and the rejected save shows no error at all
findings.summary: \"Save changes\" is enabled even though the name field contains only spaces, and clicking it sends POST /api/segment which is answered 400 Bad Request. The page does not show any error message, field highlight or toast; the form stays exactly as it was, so the user cannot tell why the segment was not created. The console logs \"Request entities,segments,create failed: {status: 400 ...}\". (on /admin/datamodel/segment/create)
findings.expected: The form should refuse a name that is only whitespace (Save disabled or a message next to the name field, e.g. \"Name is required\"), or, if the server rejects the save, the page should show the error next to the form so the user knows the segment was not created.
findings.actual: \"Save changes\" is enabled even though the name field contains only spaces, and clicking it sends POST /api/segment which is answered 400 Bad Request. The page does not show any error message, field highlight or toast; the form stays exactly as it was, so the user cannot tell why the segment was not created. The console logs \"Request entities,segments,create failed: {status: 400 ...}\".
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai, open /admin/datamodel/segments and click "New segment" (URL /admin/datamodel/segment/create)
Click "Select a table", choose Sample Database -> Orders
Click "Add filters to narrow your answer", pick the field "agent10-Total Amount" (the Orders Total field), leave the operator "Between", type Min 10 and Max 100, click "Add filter"
Click the "Name Your Segment" field and press the space bar three times so the field holds only spaces and looks empty
Type any text into "Describe Your Segment" (e.g. "agent9 spaces name test") — "Save changes" turns blue and enabled although no name is visible
Click "Save changes": the request POST /api/segment is answered 400, nothing on the page changes and no error message is shown anywhere

findings.actual: Opening a row's details replaces the address with /admin/tools/tasks/37, and closing the details replaces it with bare /admin/tools/tasks — the task filter is gone from the address while the list still shows the filtered 3 rows and the filter box still says "sync". Reloading then drops the filter: the unfiltered list (1-50) comes back and the filter box is empty.
reproSteps: Sign in with eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1, open https://5501-ifu9zeza11kw2jt1zrm8o.e2b.app/admin/tools/tasks
In 'Filter by task' type sync and pick the option 'sync' from the dropdown — the list shrinks to the 3 sync runs and the address becomes …/admin/tools/tasks?task=sync
Click any row of the list — the 'Task details' dialog opens and the address becomes …/admin/tools/tasks/<id>
Press Escape to close the dialog — the address is now …/admin/tools/tasks (no task=sync) while the filter box still shows sync
Reload the page — the filter is lost and all tasks are listed again

findings.name: Adding a group in a stale second tab fails with a 500 that the page swallows silently
findings.summary: The click sends POST /api/permissions/membership, which answers 500; the console logs the failed request plus an uncaught page error, the tick never appears next to "Administrators", the row keeps reading "Default", and nothing on the page tells the person anything went wrong — the dropdown just stays as it was. (on /admin/people)
findings.expected: Adding a group the person already has either does nothing visible (the app notices the membership exists and shows it ticked, or refreshes the row) or fails with a clear message next to the action; in no case does the request crash with a 500 that is swallowed without a word.
findings.actual: The click sends POST /api/permissions/membership, which answers 500; the console logs the failed request plus an uncaught page error, the tick never appears next to "Administrators", the row keeps reading "Default", and nothing on the page tells the person anything went wrong — the dropdown just stays as it was.
reproSteps: Sign in as eval@momentic.ai, open /admin/people, and open a second browser tab on /admin/people as well.

In the first tab, click the Groups cell of the "Jordan Ellis / jordan@example.test" row and click "Administrators" in the dropdown: the membership is saved (POST /api/permissions/membership → 200) and the row starts reading "Admin".
Now switch to the second tab, which was loaded before that change and still shows "Default" for Jordan Ellis.
In the second tab click the Groups cell of the Jordan Ellis row (the dropdown shows only "All Users" ticked, "Administrators" unticked, because the tab is stale) and click "Administrators".
Watch the page and the network: POST /api/permissions/membership → 500, no tick appears, the row still says "Default", no error is shown.

findings.actual: Typing only spaces into \"Key name *\" enables the \"Create\" button; clicking it sends the request, which the server refuses with 400. findings.name: Unresolvable SSH tunnel host shows a raw Netty exception ("DefaultConnectFuture[agent11@ssh.example.com/<unresolved>:22]... execute: null")
findings.summary: The red error panel under the form shows the raw internal exception instead of a readable reason: «Metabase tried, but couldn't connect / DefaultConnectFuture[agent11@ssh.example.com/<unresolved>:22]: Failed (UnresolvedAddressException) to execute: null». Below it only two irrelevant hints follow ("Try using a secure connection (SSL)", "Check Metabase user permissions"). Nothing tells the admin that the SSH tunnel host could not be resolved. With a resolvable SSH host (localhost) the same failure is worded properly ("Hmm, we couldn't connect to the database / Make sure your Host and Port settings are correct"), so only the unresolvable-host path leaks the exception. (on /admin/databases/create)

Below it only two irrelevant hints follow ("Try using a secure connection (SSL)", "Check Metabase user permissions"). Nothing tells the admin that the SSH tunnel host could not be resolved. With a resolvable SSH host (localhost) the same failure is worded properly ("Hmm, we couldn't connect to the database / Make sure your Host and Port settings are correct"), so only the unresolvable-host path leaks the exception.
reproSteps: Sign in with eval@momentic.ai / momentic-eval-1 and open https://5501-ifu9zeza11kw2jt1zrm8o.e2b.app/admin/databases, then click 'Add database' (form opens with Database type = PostgreSQL)

findings.name: On the Logs page, closing the \"Customize log levels\" dialog drops the log filter from the address, so a reload loses it
findings.summary: On the Logs page, clicking \"Customize log levels\" changes the address to /admin/tools/logs/levels and pressing Escape returns to /admin/tools/logs, but the ?query=api%2Fhealth part is gone from the address while the Filter logs box still shows \"api/health\". Reloading then loads /admin/tools/logs with an empty Filter logs box and the whole unfiltered log, so the filter is silently lost — a different page and dialog from the Tasks one. (on /admin/tools/logs)
findings.expected: Closing the \"Customize log levels\" dialog should leave the address as it was (/admin/tools/logs?query=api%2Fhealth), so the log filter survives a reload or a Back step, exactly as it does when the dialog is never opened.
findings.actual: On the Logs page, clicking \"Customize log levels\" changes the address to /admin/tools/logs/levels and pressing Escape returns to /admin/tools/logs, but the ?query=api%2Fhealth part is gone from the address while the Filter logs box still shows \"api/health\". Reloading then loads /admin/tools/logs with an empty Filter logs box and the whole unfiltered log, so the filter is silently lost — a different page and dialog from the Tasks one.
reproSteps: Sign in and open /admin/tools/logs (Admin > Tools > Logs).
Type api/health into "Filter logs": the address becomes /admin/tools/logs?query=api%2Fhealth and only matching lines are listed.
Click "Customize log levels" (the address changes to /admin/tools/logs/levels).
Press Escape to close the dialog.
Reload the page with the browser's reload button: the Filter logs box is empty and the full unfiltered log is shown, although the box held api/health a moment before.
